$doc: Vyomi capability registry — GCP Secret Manager. One entry per console section; level per substrate (nano = shared core, also dev_server/unified ingress; offline = appliance). Proven by tests/conformance/test_capabilities.py — a claim the backend does not honour fails CI.

gcp.secret-manager.version.crud.title: Versions (add, list, access, enable, disable, destroy)

gcp.secret-manager.replication.title: Replication policy (locations) and encryption (CMEK)
limitations: The chosen replication policy (automatic or user-managed locations) and any customer-managed encryption key name are stored on the secret and returned by the API exactly as configured; Vyomi keeps one copy of the payload and does not physically replicate it across locations or encrypt it with the named Cloud KMS key.

gcp.secret-manager.rotation.title: Rotation
limitations: The rotation period and next rotation time are stored and returned; Vyomi does not run a rotation schedule or add versions automatically.

gcp.secret-manager.expiration.title: Expiration
limitations: An expiration time (or TTL converted to one at create time) is stored and returned; Vyomi does not automatically delete the secret once it expires.

gcp.secret-manager.notifications.title: Notifications (Pub/Sub topics)
limitations: Topic resource names are stored on the secret and returned by the API; Vyomi does not publish a Pub/Sub message on rotation or version events.

gcp.secret-manager.version-aliases.title: Version aliases
limitations: Alias-to-version mappings are stored on the secret and returned by the API; unlike the real service, Vyomi's access/version calls don't accept an alias in place of a version number yet — reference versions by number or "latest".

gcp.secret-manager.permissions.title: Permissions (IAM policy)
limitations: Per-secret IAM policy (getIamPolicy/setIamPolicy/testIamPermissions) isn't backed by a Vyomi backend yet.

gcp.secret-manager.logs.title: Logs
limitations: Cloud Logging audit-log entries for secret access aren't backed by a Vyomi backend yet.

gcp.secret-manager.regional-secrets.title: Regional secrets
limitations: Regional secrets (projects/{p}/locations/{location}/secrets/...) aren't backed by a Vyomi backend yet — only global (multi/single-region) secrets are simulated.
